description: Distilled systolic I/O flash pack: hide load-store with PE streams. Recipe-driven PE/SIMD. Not spend-DSP, not the 90-skill dump, not an AutoSA netlist clone.

skills.pattern: working GEMM still uses bulk local_A/local_B then sequential compute then store, so one-call latency is load+compute+store
skills.strategy: INLINE-off load_A, load_B, mm_pe, drain_B, store_C under DATAFLOW. Instantiated PE_NUM mm_pe calls. Goal is hide load-store, not fill 9024 DSP.
required_steps: keep kernel.h ABI and INTERFACE lines
DATAFLOW region is only function calls and stream declarations
PE_NUM explicit mm_pe() calls from the recipe (16 default float 64^3, 32 for intel/getting_started/hcl/int16, 8 for catapult)
guards: DATAFLOW on one LCST body is not hide load-store
do not name a function PE if a PE macro exists

skills.pattern: SIMD moved as struct-of-floats or scalar fifo.read() inside the MAC loop, forcing II>=4
skills.strategy: Stream SIMD as ap_uint<pack_bits>. Float union only for data_t float. Integer types use bit slices.
required_steps: one fifo.read() of packed bits per PE beat, then unpack to scalars
never stream a struct of floats
guards: pack_bits follows the recipe: 128 for 4xfloat, 64 for 2xfloat, 32 for 2xu16

skills.pattern: Crow complete-partition mux_case_0 II=4, or nested pe_k0/compute_j with LOOP_FLATTEN off restarting the pipeline
skills.strategy: Crow[J] ram_2p BRAM. One pe_kj pipeline of (K/SIMD)*J beats. Fuse init/drain. No DEPENDENCE inter false.
required_steps: BIND_STORAGE Crow ram_2p bram; never ARRAY_PARTITION Crow complete
guards: DSP near recipe (float PE*SIMD*5, uint16 PE*SIMD, uint32 ~PE*SIMD*3)

skills.pattern: B is fully buffered on-chip and broadcast, or DRAM load is outside DATAFLOW so compute waits for a full memcpy
skills.strategy: Stream packed B along a PE chain. Always forward; drain_B consumes the last fifo. Loaders are DATAFLOW tasks; compute never touches m_axi.
required_steps: load_A / load_B / store_C are INLINE-off tasks
guards: mismatched load vs PE trip deadlocks streams

skills.pattern: PE_NUM does not cover I, but the i-tile loop sits inside mm_pe so two pe_kj trips serialize in one DATAFLOW firing
skills.strategy: When I/PE_NUM>1, wrap DATAFLOW in the top i0 += PE_NUM loop. Tasks see one tile. STREAM depth >= 8.
required_steps: top: for i0 += PE_NUM { DATAFLOW load/compute/store of that tile }
mm_pe / load_B / drain_B have no inner i-tile loop
do not dual-MAC two rows in one beat as a substitute
guards: getting_started rank-1 is two DATAFLOW tiles, not a 2x serialized pe_kj

skills.pattern: DATAFLOW on shared local_A/B/C; AutoSA netlist clone; struct-of-floats FIFOs; complete-partition Crow
skills.strategy: Reject shared on-chip A/B/C across DATAFLOW tasks. Reject AutoSA interconnect clone. Reject complete-partition Crow.
required_steps: scan for local_A used by more than one task — reject
scan for ARRAY_PARTITION Crow complete — reject
scan for AutoSA interconnect names — reject
guards: this pack is hide load-store, not spend 5000 DSP
